name: Topic Depth Analysis
description: Evaluates the depth, specificity, and vertical exploration of topics within a text. Generative AI models, trained to predict the most statistically probable next words across a vast, generalized corpus, excel at producing broad, superficial overviews. They 'smooth out' information, often failing to drill down into the highly specific nuances, edge cases, and granular terminology that characterize true human expertise. Human writers with domain knowledge typically introduce a concept and progressively explore its specific mechanisms, exceptions, and deeper layers.
mechanism: The system processes the text to identify core topics and maps their expansion. It uses natural language processing (NLP) to measure the ratio of general, high-level vocabulary to hyper-specific, domain-restricted terminology. Furthermore, it analyzes the grammatical structure to detect patterns of 'vertical elaboration' (e.g., following a general statement with multiple sentences detailing the *how* and *why*). A text that touches on many concepts but relies entirely on generalized vocabulary and repetitive, high-level summaries is flagged as indicative of AI generation.
useCase: Highly effective for analyzing technical writing, academic essays, research papers, and professional articles where deep domain expertise and granular detail are fundamental expectations.
strengths:
• Identifies a fundamental cognitive limitation in current LLMs: the difficulty of generating truly novel, deep insights rather than synthesizing existing, broad summaries.
• Robust against simple paraphrasing, as rearranging superficial content does not magically inject the missing depth or domain-specific terminology.
limitations:
• May produce false positives on human-written texts designed to be introductory or superficial (e.g., brief executive summaries, marketing copy, or basic overview articles).
• Less effective on extremely short texts where 'drilling down' into a topic is physically impossible due to length constraints.
parameters:
Analysis: Domain Terminology & Concept Elaboration Tracking
Metric: Ratio of Broad vs. Specific Statements
Output: 0-100 Superficiality/Depth Score
accuracy: Moderate to High — 75-84% accuracy. Especially reliable when combined with Lexical Sophistication and Information Density metrics to build a comprehensive profile of text 'shallowness'.

references.title: Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. NeurIPS.
Jurafsky, D. & Martin, J.H. (2024). Speech and Language Processing. 3rd Edition.
